name: Madd
source:
The tough and scary looking shopkeeper in town. 

In contrast to his strong body, his speciality is precision work. At the dump site of the abandoned factory, he is scavenging junk which he repairs and sells. 

He tends to getting upset over trivial matters.

"You again! Just what did you come here!?"

[From the [url=http://key.visualarts.gr.jp/harmonia/]official website[/url]]
